faqs.question: How does Orbitvu improve e-commerce productivity?
faqs.answer: Orbitvu automates shooting, clipping, and editing, reducing the production time of the visuals produced by up to 70%.

faqs.question: Is Orbitvu suitable for non-photographers?
faqs.answer: Yes, thanks to an intuitive interface and automated settings, even without photo expertise, you can produce professional images.

faqs.question: What types of content can you create with Orbitvu?
faqs.answer: Orbitvu makes it possible to produce HD photos, 360 animations, videos and visuals optimized for the web and marketplaces.

faqs.question: Does Orbitvu integrate with e-commerce platforms?
faqs.answer: Yes, it is compatible with Shopify, Magento, and other platforms, allowing for quick and automated publication of visuals.

faqs.question: What is the return on investment of an Orbitvu studio?
faqs.answer: Automation reduces operational costs, accelerates product delivery, and improves conversions through high-quality visuals.
